reviewedReason: schema-parser now follows identical pipeline with root-mapping guard, fixed parseConfig ollama field requirements in interface

yaml-parser-contract.reason: All YAML parsers follow the required pipeline. (1) readFile(filePath, 'utf-8') is used in every parser: architecture-parser.ts:8, aspect-parser.ts:15, config-parser.ts:18, flow-parser.ts:8, node-parser.ts:19, schema-parser.ts:8, secrets-parser.ts:16. (2) parseYaml(content) as Record<string, unknown> is used in all: architecture-parser.ts:9, aspect-parser.ts:16, config-parser.ts:19, flow-parser.ts:9, node-parser.ts:20, schema-parser.ts:9, secrets-parser.ts:22. (3) Manual type guards are used throughout — typeof x !== 'string', !Array.isArray(x), typeof x !== 'object', etc. (4) Descriptive errors include file path and field: e.g. aspect-parser.ts:13,23,33 uses 'yg-aspect.yaml at ${aspectYamlPath}: ...', node-parser.ts:27,29,54,98 uses 'yg-node.yaml at ${filePath}: ...', config-parser.ts:28 uses '${filename}: missing or invalid name field' (config-level format), architecture-parser.ts:12 uses 'yg-architecture.yaml: ...' (config-level). (5) All return typed domain objects. Invariants: no zod/joi/schema libraries imported anywhere; all required fields checked individually with clear messages; optional fields use fallback defaults (e.g. config-parser.ts:32-48 DEFAULT_QUALITY, secrets-parser.ts extractSecretFields returns partial); no parser writes to disk — artifact-reader.ts and drift-state-store.ts are not YAML parsers and are out of scope for this aspect.

silent-missing-files.reason: All io-layer functions that handle optional files/directories follow the silent-missing-files pattern. artifact-reader.ts:12-17 wraps readdir in try/catch and returns [] when the directory (aspects/, flows/, schemas/ artifact dirs) is absent. drift-state-store.ts:126-131 wraps stat(.drift-state) in try/catch and returns {} when the drift-state path doesn't exist; scanJsonFiles (lines 21-24) also returns [] on readdir failure. secrets-parser.ts:15-19 wraps readFile in try/catch and returns undefined when yg-secrets.yaml is missing. The individual YAML parsers (aspect-parser, flow-parser, node-parser, schema-parser, architecture-parser, config-parser) correctly throw on missing/invalid files because they are only called with paths that the caller has already resolved — their errors signal programmer bugs, not missing optional state.

diagnostic-logging.reason: All catch blocks that swallow errors (return fallback/default instead of re-throwing) call debugWrite() with the required format [module] operation: error.message. Specifically: artifact-reader.ts:14 (readdir fallback → []); drift-state-store.ts:24 (scanJsonFiles readdir), :57 (removeEmptyParents), :74 (readNodeDriftState → undefined), :129 (readDriftState stat → {}), :140 (readDriftState JSON parse, continues to yaml fallback); secrets-parser.ts:17 (readFile → undefined). Files with no catch blocks (architecture-parser.ts, aspect-parser.ts, audit-log.ts, config-parser.ts, flow-parser.ts, node-parser.ts, schema-parser.ts) all re-throw or propagate errors naturally. All messages include module identifier, operation name, and error message as required.
